meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
Shaadi ke liye budget mein online **silk-blend, georgette, chiffon, organza ya Banarasi-look sarees** achhi rahengi. ₹300–₹1,500 mein guest ya family function ke liye kaafi options mil rahe hain; better-quality silk aur handloom-look sarees ke liye ₹1,500–₹3,500 ka budget rakhein.[1][2][5][6]

## Budget ke hisaab se best choices

- **₹300–₹600: Georgette ya chiffon saree** — halka fabric, sequins/embroidery ke saath; sangeet ya reception guest ke liye. Flipkart par wedding georgette sarees lagbhag ₹283–₹440 se dikh rahi hain.[5]
- **₹500–₹1,000: Art-silk ya Kanjivaram-look saree** — traditional appearance aur shaadi ke main function ke liye suitable. Flipkart par art-silk/Kanjivaram-style options lagbhag ₹442–₹898 ke range mein hain.[5]
- **₹700–₹1,500: Banarasi-look ya silk-blend saree** — zyada rich finish; Libas par silk-blend wedding sarees sale mein ₹759–₹1,259 ke aas-paas mil rahi hain.[7]
- **₹900–₹1,500: Zari-work ya Banarasi silk-blend saree** — close family function ke liye; Nykaa Fashion par zari-work option ₹899 aur Banarasi silk/Kanjivaram-style option ₹1,320 ke aas-paas listed hai.[6]
- **₹1,500–₹3,500: Chanderi, Paithani-look ya quality silk saree** — reception ya important family event ke liye polished choice; Nykaa par Chanderi-Paithani style ₹2,240 aur gharchola silk ₹3,146 ke aas-paas listed hai.[6]

## Color aur design suggestions

- **Lal, wine ya rani pink:** shaadi ya reception  
- **Mustard, yellow ya orange:** haldi  
- **Green, teal ya magenta:** sangeet  
- **Pastel pink, lavender ya powder blue:** daytime wedding  
- **Black:** evening reception, agar family tradition allow kare  

**Best value pick:** ₹700–₹1,200 ki **silk-blend Banarasi ya Kanjivaram-look saree with zari border**—photo mein festive dikhegi aur budget bhi control mein rahega.

Order karne se pehle customer photos, blouse-piece length, saree fabric, return policy aur delivery date zaroor check karein; ₹200–₹500 wali listings mein fabric aksar “silk-look” ya synthetic ho sakta hai.[2][3]
